connector.name: breedsim-mcp
connector.registryDescription: Breeding-scheme simulation via AlphaSimR. Needs R, AlphaSimR and libtirpc-dev on the host.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package breedsim-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the musharna account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: OMP_NUM_THREADS
env.description: Pinned to '1' at import so AlphaSimR results are reproducible; overriding it makes runs non-deterministic and the server reports that in every response.
